calls.head: Quality over quantity for Pittsburgh
calls.body: Pittsburgh ranks 5th of 32 for shot quality (one expected goal for every 15.0 unblocked shots); Montréal ranks 30th for keeping shots to the outside.
calls.call: Pittsburgh needs no more than its usual 15.0 unblocked shots per expected goal.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 1 and 1 games this season
calls.happened: Pittsburgh needed 17.3 unblocked shots per expected goal, against its usual 15.0.

calls.head: Special teams tilt toward Pittsburgh
calls.body: Pittsburgh ranks 10th of 32 on the power play (7.6 expected goals per 60); Montréal ranks 27th on the penalty kill.
calls.call: Pittsburgh’s power play creates at least its usual 7.6 expected goals per 60.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 1 and 1 games this season
calls.happened: Pittsburgh’s power play created 9.4 expected goals per 60 in 5:07 of 5-on-4 time, against its usual 7.6, and scored 2 goals.

PIT.head: We had this close to even (56% for Pittsburgh), and Pittsburgh came through.

MTL.head: We had this close to even (44% for Montréal), and it went Pittsburgh’s way.

surprises.head: A rough night for J. Dobes
surprises.body: J. Dobes allowed 6 goals on shots worth 2.8 expected goals, 3.2 more than expected. Starting goalies had a night this rough about once every 40 starts over the last three seasons.
